description:

You'll have the chance to work on basic and/or detailed design, depen­ding on your expe­ri­ence and inte­rests. In this role, you'll be deve­lo­ping struc­tural solu­tions for modern vessels and contri­bu­ting to advanced, inno­va­tive projects in the ship­buil­ding industry.
We offer a colla­bo­ra­tive and suppor­tive envi­ron­ment where your skills will make a real impact and where you can grow.
Loca­tion: Gdynia
Work mode: On-site / Hybrid
Employ­ment type: B2B / Perma­nent (full-time)

Degree in fields such as naval archi­tec­ture, mecha­nical engi­nee­ring, or related disci­plines
Com­mer­cial expe­ri­ence in ship hull design - we are looking for specia­lists at all levels of expe­ri­ence
Pro­fi­ciency in AutoCAD and at least one of the follo­wing programs: FORAN (currently preferred), NUPAS, NAPA - as our projects are carried out in various design envi­ron­ments
Lan­guages: Polish (native) and English (good command in spea­king and writing- minimum B2 level)
Nice to have:
Expe­ri­ence in prepa­ring clas­si­fi­ca­tion society docu­men­ta­tion
Rock solid stabi­lity of a company esta­blished in 1966 in Germany with more than 120 bran­ches
